sources.title: HABS CA-356: Hollyhock House
sources.inspection: Read exterior and layout description: 121 by 99 ft overall body, 10-degree battered upper walls, belt course, 68-ft northern entry gallery, 16 by 26 ft east upper bridge, terrace stair finials, stucco lower walls and concrete ornament. Historic alterations compared against current plan and photos.

sources.title: Official Hollyhock House guide, 2024, room layout page 41
sources.inspection: Read timeline and individually inspected current first/second floor plan: west living room, music/study flanks, dining/kitchen north, gallery south, loggia/courtyard, upper east rooms and open bridge, south semicircular garden.

sources.title: Aerial roof context
sources.inspection: Inspected current north-up roof and terraces: open courtyard, east bridge, west living projection, two west lawns, east circular pool, south shaped garden, north entrance gallery. Separate arts buildings excluded.

sources.title: USGS 3DEP CA_LosAngeles_B23 bare-earth DEM
sources.inspection: Queried the house coordinate and downloaded unmodified Float32 tile locked to raster 91959, exported at one metre in UTM11N. Bilinear two-metre review grid, datum 150.0724 m NAVD88 beside north entry gallery. Source terrain under the house is interpolated; no flattening or fitting.

scope: Surviving main-house exterior and attached terraces; no photo pixels embedded.
